provenance.access_scope: Used only manifest-v4.json and the source pages listed in that manifest, enumerated in allowed_sources.
provenance.excluded_material: No existing development datasets, retrieval/evaluation reports, candidate outputs, ADR result sections, or holdout files/results were inspected or used.
provenance.content_note: Prompts are drafts grounded in the pinned corpus examples; answerability labels are cohort-balancing metadata, not acceptable-example identifiers.

families.name: Discovery by name, text, or package
families.intent: Test whether retrieval finds an operational example matching the requested discovery mode and its search key.

families.name: Scope work to a chosen location or resource
families.intent: Test whether the example applies to the requested path, directory, filesystem, or named unit, including the requested scope boundary.

families.name: Filter results to matching content or attributes
families.intent: Test whether retrieval supports the requested match semantics and any case, type, or time filters.

families.name: Keep output narrow and easy to scan
families.intent: Test whether a retrieved example can produce the requested concise form or exact result subset.

families.name: Send data or an operation to a destination
families.intent: Test whether the example supports the requested destination and preserves the stated source or destination behavior.

families.name: Respect existing state and overwrite behavior
families.intent: Test whether the example supports the requested interaction, replacement, or preservation constraint.

families.name: Inspect an item or apply an action to it
families.intent: Distinguish examples that reveal, list, or print an item from those that open, modify, or control it.

families.name: Honor time and ordering requirements
families.intent: Test whether the requested chronological, numeric, or delayed behavior is actually shown.

families.name: Choose a representation, format, or unit
families.intent: Test whether the retrieved operation supports the requested output representation or measurement units.

families.name: Use streams, pipelines, and follow behavior
families.intent: Test whether the example supports the requested stdin, stdout, clipboard, pipeline, or live-follow flow.

families.name: Operate on a named platform resource or item
families.intent: Test whether the specific platform operation and target semantics match the requested action.

families.name: Gather a constrained inventory or diagnostic
families.intent: Test whether a retrieved example covers the requested inventory, diagnostic filter, and output constraints.
